LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_ConfirmationAllTabsAndOperation: Are you sure you want to set the settings of all pages back to default?\nThis includes the settings for operations as well.\nIf new hediffs are found, they will be added, old ones will be removed.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowEasyTooltip:
Severity and Immunity:
If the immunity is ahead of the severity level by at least the value you specify, this type of medicine is chosen.

Severity and NOT Immunity:
If severity is below the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.

NOT Severity and Immunity:
If immunity is ahead of the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.

This is the third condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowStandardTooltip: If none of the previous statements apply, this type of medicine is chosen.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowProblematicTooltip:
Severity and Immunity:
If immunity is ahead of severity by the amount you specify or less, this type of medicine is chosen.

Severity and NOT Immunity:
If severity is greater than the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.

NOT Severity and Immunity:
If immunity is below the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.

This is the second condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowImmunityTooltip: If the immunity is lower than the set value, this type of medicine is chosen. Without this option every new hediff of this group gets probably tended with the medicine for 'acute'.\n\nThis is the first condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowSeverityLowerTooltip:
Severity and NOT Immunity:
If the severity is lower than the set value, this type of medicine is chosen. Without this option every new hediff of this group gets probably tended with the medicine for 'acute'.
This is the first condition to be checked.

Total Tend Quality:
Only applies to hediffs that have total tend quality and severity:
If the severity is below the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.
This is the third condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowSeverityGreaterTooltip:
Only applies to hediffs that have total tend quality and severity:
If the severity is greater than the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.

This is the second condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowTotalTendLowerTooltip: If the total tend quality is lower than the set value, this type of medicine is chosen. Without this option every new hediff of this group gets probably tended with the medicine for 'standard'.\n\nThis is the first condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowBodyPartDamagedGreaterToolti: If the bodypart the hediff is applied to is more damaged than the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.\n\nThis is the first condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowBodyPartDamagedLowerTooltip:
If the bodypart the hediff is applied to is less damaged than the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.
For most hediffs in this category, except bleeding ones, you probably will set "no medicine" or even 'no care'.

This is the third condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_RowBodyDamagedGreaterTooltip: If the whole body is more damaged than the set value, this type of medicine is chosen.\n\nThis is the second condition to be checked.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_GroupsTooltip:
Hediffs are grouped by whether they use immunity/severity/total tend quality.


A few notes about healing/tending: 
The type of a medicine is not a factor in the calculation how long a doctor needs to tend a hediff. That means better medicines does not make tending take less time.

Batch tending happens with every medicine type.

In vanilla the healing of wounds/bodyparts works as following: Every X ticks a certain amount of damage gets restored. The amount depends on a few factors, e.g. wound tended, patient in bed, tend quality and so on. But no matter if a patient has 10 hediffs each causing 1 damage or one hediff causing 10 damage, the time needed to be fully healed is the same (as long as the circumstances are the same).

LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_DetailedSettings:
Detailed settings:

Disabled:
Set a medical care category for a stage.
The healer will try to use that medicine, if it is not available, a worse one and so on (like vanilla).
It is also possible to set 'no medical care'.

Active:
Set a list of medicines for a stage.
Use drag dropping to change the order of the medicines. Use right click to remove a medicine.
The Healer will try to use the first listed medicine, if not available, the second one and so on.
If none of the medicines in the list is available, the doctor will tend without medicine.
It is not possible to add 'no medical care' to the list.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_OperationsMaxCare: The maximum medical care for operations:
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_OperationsMaxCareTooltip: Note that the maximum medical care category set in a pawns player settings is respected.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_OperationsWorseMed: Try to take the worst medicine, which promises maximum success.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_OperationsWorseMedTooltip: The surgery success chance depends on a few factors and is limited to 98%. This option ensures that the best allowed medicine is taken only if it is necessary, otherwise weaker if the 98% can be reached with it.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_OperationsOnlyWhenBestSuccess: Operate only when maximum success is expected.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_OperationsOnlyWhenBestSuccessTo: This option causes surgeries to only be started if the expected surgery success chance reaches the upper limit of 98%.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_OperationsUseBest: Take the best available medicine if the surgery may cause a hediff, whose duration may then be affected by the used medicine.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_OperationsUseBestTooltip: In vanilla there is only one operation type which falls in this category: 'Implant xenogerm'.\nThe medicine used is a factor in the duration of the 'Xenogermination coma'.

LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_ShowMainButtonTooltip: If you do not want the mods main button to appear at the bottom bar you can disable it.\n\nThe gui can be opened from the mod settings as well.

LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_AmountMedicineCarry: Count of medicine a colonist can carry:
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_AmountMedicineCarryTooltip:
In vanilla a colonist is allowed to carry 3 medicines of a certain type.
Use this setting to adjust the amount to your likings.

NOTE: I only did a quick test if it is working without issues for extreme numbers.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_TendingsSearchRange: Search range for medicine when tending:
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_TendingsSearchRangeTooltip:
Set the range a doctor will look for medicines when tending a patient.

The starting point is the position of the patient.

Set to '-1' to search the whole map (vanilla).
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_AlwaysOpenNewWindowForDetailedM: Always open a new window when clicking the medicine row of a hediff stage in the detailed view in the mods main gui:
If set to false, the new window only opens if necessary - if there is too many medicine types which makes drag dropping difficult.
LanguageData.Kopp_CYM_AlwaysShowCopyPasteForEachHedif: Always show the copy/paste buttons for each stage of a hediff:
If set to false, the buttons are only shown for a single hediff stage while the mouse is close to it.
